items.title: Separate Page, Focus, Flow, and Narrate runtimes
items.description: Owner-mandated step 1: independent Page, Focus, Flow and Narrate state, lifecycle, timers, callbacks, DOM/rendering and styles. Matching private module layouts and public contracts permit a later consolidation decision. Approved waves: A baseline/contracts; B Page + Focus; C Flow; D Narrate; E remove shared behavior and prove isolation. Acceptance covers import boundaries, private resource ownership, 12 cross-mode transitions, four same-mode cases, stale-session rejection, preserved per-mode behavior and live audio/UI evidence.
items.notes: Owner set mode isolation first and approved Phase C on 2026-09-23. Phase D: U1–U8 PASS for the specification; no project extensions. Full inline spec has exact paths, test assertions, gates, two-correction ceiling and per-wave rollback. Execution requires a clean isolated checkout and fresh baseline tests/build; no code, tests or live QA have run in this review. Existing ISO-1 adapters remain completed historical groundwork. No TTS tuning, feature additions or deduplication. Four downstream items remain Blocked/Stub until separation closes and their edit sites are re-specified.
